categories.label: Production Impact & Ownership
categories.description: what was built, owned and operated in production, and the measurable outcomes behind it. Duty lists score low; owned results with numbers score high.

categories.label: System Design & Scale
categories.description: systems designed or re-architected: distributed services, data and event pipelines, migrations, reliability and performance work. Using a scalable tool is a skill; designing with it is design.

categories.label: Technical Leadership & Mentoring
categories.description: leading projects or people: tech-lead ownership, mentoring, code review, standards, hiring, cross-team delivery, teaching at scale.

categories.label: Technical Depth & Breadth
categories.description: depth in the primary stack shown through work evidence, plus breadth across data, messaging, cloud, containers, CI/CD, observability, testing and security.

bonus_description: technical writing or teaching footprint, open source maintainership, founder or first-engineer experience, relevant certifications, side projects with real users.
